properties.description: Compares the build with the LAST RELEASE's record (fixtures/mcp_surface_at_last_release.json): tools, argument schemas, the reply shapes of a fixed scenario, the vocabulary (node types with properties, edge types) and the deprecations that release announced, both read from its own describe_schema at a bless. Anything taken away fails unless the record marks it deprecated; a deprecated item still served passes; a deprecated tool no longer listed must still answer its old name with what to do. The listed narrowings (UNADVERTISED, ENUM_ATTACHED) keep their proofs. Name kept for its history; registered 2026-10-14 when the retirement rule rewrote its check.
properties.name: tests/the_mcp_surface_only_grows.rs — the MCP surface shrinks only through a deprecating release
